Do not hand-edit these. Regenerate them instead.

- `healthcare/public/frontend/assets/*` (hashed `patient_portal-<hash>.js/.css/.map`) and `healthcare/public/patient_portal/assets`: Vite build output from `patient_portal/`. Edit `patient_portal/src` and run `yarn build`. Pre-commit excludes `healthcare/public/frontend/assets/` and `healthcare/public/dist/`.
- `healthcare/www/patient_portal.html`: the index HTML that the frappe-ui Vite plugin writes (`indexHtmlPath`).
- `patient_portal/auto-imports.d.ts` and `patient_portal/components.d.ts`: auto-generated type stubs.
- `healthcare/locale/main.pot`: regenerated weekly by the `generate-pot-file.yml` workflow. Crowdin manages the `.po` translations.
- `yarn.lock`: lockfile. Change it only through yarn.
- Doctype `.json` files are produced by the Frappe DocType editor. Edit them carefully, keep the key order and keep `modified` timestamps updated.
- `healthcare/__init__.py`: semantic-release rewrites the `__version__` string in it.
- Ignored by git: `dist/`, `node_modules/`, `__pycache__/`, `*.egg-info`, `healthcare/docs/current`.
- `.secrets.baseline`: the detect-secrets baseline.
